definitions.explanation: A variety of language spoken in a particular region that differs from the standard language in vocabulary, pronunciation, and grammar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧{方言|ほうげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東北|とうほく}→東北：27542_touhoku⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{方言|ほうげん}です。
examples.english: This word is from the Tohoku dialect.

examples.japanese: {方言|ほうげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反映|はんえい}→反映：04327_hanei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Dialects reflect the culture of their regions.

notes:
JAPANESE DIALECTS:
Japan has many regional dialects, broadly categorized as:

- ⟦{関西弁|かんさいべん}→関西弁：17855_kansaiben⟧ - Kansai dialect (Osaka, Kyoto area)
- {東北弁|とうほくべん} - Tohoku dialect (northeastern Japan)
- {九州弁|きゅうしゅうべん} - Kyushu dialect
- {北海道弁|ほっかいどうべん} - Hokkaido dialect
- {沖縄方言|おきなわほうげん} - Okinawan dialects

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {方言|ほうげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ - to speak a dialect
- {方言|ほうげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ - dialect comes out (unintentionally)
- {方言|ほうげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ - to have a strong dialect
- お{国|くに}{言葉|ことば} - regional speech (more casual/affectionate term)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{標準語|ひょうじゅんご}→標準語：07421_hyoujungo⟧ - standard language
- ⟦{訛|なま}り→訛り：07420_namari⟧ - accent, dialect influence
- ⟦{共通語|きょうつうご}→共通語：16600_kyoutsuugo⟧ - common language
- ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ - local speech

CULTURAL NOTE:
Dialects are increasingly valued as cultural heritage. Many people use dialect with family and friends while speaking ⟦{標準語|ひょうじゅんご}→標準語：07421_hyoujungo⟧ in formal settings.

REGISTER:
Neutral. Standard term for academic and everyday use.
